shots.name: Storm
shots.narration: Every app on your phone insists its message matters most.
shots.action: A single notification lands, then forty more arrive faster and faster across a bright frame; the camera pushes in, the frame shakes, red creeps in at the edges.
shots.goal: Recognize the feeling of a phone that never stops asking for attention.
shots.focalPoint: The first centered card, then the whole crowded frame.
shots.transition: Everything stops dead; a dark wave opens from the center.
shots.sound: A ping on every card, a nervous pulse, a riser that cuts to silence.

shots.name: Lull
shots.narration: Lull holds those interruptions back, and gathers them into one quiet digest.
shots.action: The wave sweeps outward; every card is pulled into the center and folds into a single digest card whose count climbs to forty held.
shots.goal: See interruptions become one calm object without anything being thrown away.
shots.focalPoint: The digest card at the center of the ring.
shots.transition: The digest card moves aside and opens.
shots.sound: A soft sub swell at the cut, then a warm pad under the voice.

shots.name: Digest
shots.narration: When you're ready, the digest is sorted by what needs you.
shots.action: The card expands into a sorted digest: people waiting on a decision, then things worth a look, then everything else grouped by app.
shots.goal: Understand that the digest is ordered by what needs a decision, not by arrival time.
shots.transition: The panel recedes and the ring returns as a boundary.
shots.sound: Soft plucks as each section opens.
shots.hold: Reading time for the sorted digest.

shots.name: Break through
shots.narration: Only the people you choose can still reach you, when it can't wait.
shots.action: Grey notifications drift toward the ring and dissolve at its edge; a gold card from Maya passes straight through and settles in the center.
shots.goal: Trust that quiet does not mean missing the person who needs you.
shots.focalPoint: The gold card crossing the ring.
shots.transition: The ring contracts behind the wordmark.
shots.sound: Muted taps for the ghosts, a bell when Maya breaks through.

shots.name: Wordmark
shots.action: The wordmark rises letter by letter inside the dimmed ring; the tagline and a fictional-product note follow, then a long hold.
shots.goal: Remember the name and the promise.
shots.sound: Intentional silence from the voice; the final chord and a low bell resolve and fade.
